caption: The drawing shows a single object that appears to be a long quilted skirt viewed from the front. The skirt is depicted in various shades of beige and light brown, with darker brown tones used to accentuate shadows and creases in the fabric. The waistband is visible at the top, rendered in a slightly lighter beige. The quilting pattern is presented in diagonal lines across the upper two-thirds of the skirt, while the lower third features a more elaborate design with curved, leaf-like shapes and a scalloped border, differentiating the sections with their respective stitched patterns. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the skirt and focusing attention solely on the garment.
title: Skirt
